output_text: Always structure your Ansible content into roles and collections. Each role or module must focus on a single, well-defined task. Avoid monolithic roles. All YAML files must begin with `---`. Use two spaces for indentation, never tabs. Always use `atomic_move` (implicitly via `copy`, `template` modules) for file modifications to prevent data corruption. Write idempotent tasks. Favor declarative modules over imperative `command` or `shell`. Always use the structured map style for module parameters, not the legacy `key=value` style. Avoid raw tracebacks. Run `ansible-lint` on every pull request. `ansible-test sanity --test flake8 --test ansible-doc --test pep8` `pip
